redundancy.fuzzy_sampling_method: first events ordered by event IRI

label_quality.sampling_method: first events ordered by event IRI

temporal_granularity.classification_method: XML Schema datatype with documented lexical fallback

temporal_density.coverage_gap_definition: missing decades between observed minimum and maximum year

type_consistency.consistency_interpretation: No declared constraints applied to used triples; no score is reported.
type_consistency.open_world_caveat: Missing explicit class assertions count as non-alignment under this closed profile; they are not RDF/OWL logical inconsistencies. rdfs:Resource and rdfs:Literal are handled according to their RDF semantics.

total_nodes.label: Projected graph node count
total_nodes.formula: |V| on the domain-relation projection, including isolated direct sem:Event resources.
total_nodes.source_basis: RDF 1.1 graph model; standard graph order definition; Newman network analysis.
total_nodes.rationale: Counts the number of IRI resources participating in object-property links after RDF-to-graph projection.
total_nodes.limitations: Depends on projection choices; literals, blank nodes, rdf:type, and schema predicates are excluded.
total_nodes.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
total_nodes.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

total_edges.label: Projected graph edge count
total_edges.formula: |E| on the undirected simple domain-relation projection.
total_edges.source_basis: RDF 1.1 graph model; standard graph size definition; Newman network analysis.
total_edges.rationale: Counts relation links used for graph-structural analysis.
total_edges.limitations: Predicate labels and multiedges are collapsed; schema/type predicates are excluded.
total_edges.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
total_edges.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

num_components.label: Weak/undirected connected components
num_components.formula: Number of maximal connected components in the undirected projected graph.
num_components.source_basis: Standard connected-component definition; NetworkX connected_components implementation.
num_components.rationale: Shows fragmentation of the projected EKG relation graph.
num_components.limitations: Fragmentation is not automatically poor quality; interpretation depends on dataset scope.
num_components.empty_case: No projected nodes: reject the input and emit no structural profile.

giant_component_size.label: Largest connected component size
giant_component_size.formula: |V_max|, where V_max is the largest connected component.
giant_component_size.rationale: Indicates the absolute size of the main integrated graph region.
giant_component_size.limitations: Scale-dependent; compare with giant_component_ratio for normalized interpretation.
giant_component_size.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
giant_component_size.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

giant_component_ratio.label: Giant component ratio
giant_component_ratio.source_basis: Standard giant-component concept normalized by graph order.
giant_component_ratio.rationale: Compares how much of the graph belongs to the largest connected region.
giant_component_ratio.limitations: A highly connected graph can still contain incorrect or redundant facts.
giant_component_ratio.empty_case: No projected nodes: reject the input and emit no structural profile.

avg_clustering.label: Average local clustering coefficient
avg_clustering.formula: (1 / |V|) * sum_v (2e_v / (k_v(k_v - 1))) on the undirected simple projection.
avg_clustering.source_basis: Watts-Strogatz clustering coefficient; NetworkX average_clustering implementation.
avg_clustering.rationale: Summarizes local triangle closure in event/entity neighborhoods.
avg_clustering.limitations: Sensitive to RDF projection, undirecting, and removal of literal facts.
avg_clustering.empty_case: No projected nodes: reject the input and emit no structural profile.

edge_connectivity.label: Edge connectivity
edge_connectivity.formula: Minimum number of edges whose removal disconnects the graph; set to 0 for disconnected graphs.
edge_connectivity.source_basis: Standard edge-connectivity definition; NetworkX edge_connectivity implementation.
edge_connectivity.rationale: Measures structural robustness of a connected projected graph.
edge_connectivity.limitations: Expensive on large graphs and not a direct data-quality score.
edge_connectivity.empty_case: No projected nodes: reject the input and emit no structural profile.

density.label: Graph density
density.source_basis: Standard graph-density formula; NetworkX density implementation.
density.rationale: Reports edge saturation under a fixed RDF projection.
density.limitations: Typically very small in KGs and should not be interpreted as quality by itself.
density.empty_case: No projected nodes: reject the input and emit no structural profile.

avg_degree.label: Average degree
avg_degree.formula: 2m / n for the undirected simple projection.
avg_degree.source_basis: Handshaking lemma; standard graph degree definition.
avg_degree.limitations: Sensitive to projection choices and node-type mixture.
avg_degree.empty_case: No projected nodes: reject the input and emit no structural profile.

redundancy.exact_label_duplicates.label: Exact normalized duplicate-label groups
redundancy.exact_label_duplicates.formula: Count of normalized English-label groups with frequency > 1.
redundancy.exact_label_duplicates.source_basis: Linked Data conciseness dimension from Zaveri et al.; label normalization practice from record linkage.
redundancy.exact_label_duplicates.rationale: A transparent first-pass indicator of possible duplicate event records.
redundancy.exact_label_duplicates.limitations: Identical labels can describe distinct events; this is candidate evidence, not proof.
redundancy.exact_label_duplicates.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
redundancy.exact_label_duplicates.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

redundancy.exact_duplicate_events.label: Events in exact duplicate-label groups
redundancy.exact_duplicate_events.formula: sum_l f(l) for normalized labels where f(l) > 1.
redundancy.exact_duplicate_events.source_basis: Linked Data conciseness dimension; record-linkage duplicate-candidate practice.
redundancy.exact_duplicate_events.rationale: Estimates how many event records are involved in exact-label duplicate groups.
redundancy.exact_duplicate_events.limitations: Overcounts true duplication when same labels legitimately repeat.
redundancy.exact_duplicate_events.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
redundancy.exact_duplicate_events.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

redundancy.sameas_duplicates.label: Shared owl:sameAs duplicate-candidate groups
redundancy.sameas_duplicates.formula: Count of external owl:sameAs target IRIs linked by more than one event.
redundancy.sameas_duplicates.provenance_type: adapted from Linked Data interlinking / OWL identity semantics
redundancy.sameas_duplicates.source_basis: OWL owl:sameAs semantics; Linked Data interlinking quality literature.
redundancy.sameas_duplicates.rationale: Shared identity targets are stronger duplicate candidates than labels alone.
redundancy.sameas_duplicates.limitations: owl:sameAs is often misused; shared targets still need review.
redundancy.sameas_duplicates.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
redundancy.sameas_duplicates.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

redundancy.fuzzy_duplicate_pairs.label: Fuzzy duplicate candidate pairs
redundancy.fuzzy_duplicate_pairs.formula: Exact count of non-identical sampled normalized-label pairs with RapidFuzz token-sort similarity >= 90%.
redundancy.fuzzy_duplicate_pairs.source_basis: Fellegi-Sunter record linkage; duplicate-detection literature; RapidFuzz token_sort_ratio implementation.
redundancy.fuzzy_duplicate_pairs.rationale: Finds near-duplicate labels missed by exact matching.
redundancy.fuzzy_duplicate_pairs.limitations: Deterministic IRI-ordered sample; candidates are not validated duplicates or a population estimate.
redundancy.fuzzy_duplicate_pairs.empty_case: No eligible labels: rate is null (N/A); duplicate candidate counts remain 0.

redundancy.duplication_rate.label: Exact-label duplicate candidate rate
redundancy.duplication_rate.formula: events in repeated normalized-label groups / events with eligible labels * 100.
redundancy.duplication_rate.source_basis: Linked Data conciseness dimension; thesis-specific exact-label duplicate proxy.
redundancy.duplication_rate.rationale: Provides a normalized summary of conservative duplicate-label evidence.
redundancy.duplication_rate.limitations: Uses only exact normalized labels and therefore is incomplete and potentially overinclusive.
redundancy.duplication_rate.empty_case: No eligible labels: rate is null (N/A); duplicate candidate counts remain 0.

redundancy.label_quality.label_uniquenes.label: Label uniqueness rate
redundancy.label_quality.label_uniquenes.formula: unique normalized sampled labels / sampled labels * 100.
redundancy.label_quality.label_uniquenes.source_basis: Motivated by duplicate-detection and label-quality review practice.
redundancy.label_quality.label_uniquenes.rationale: Shows how often event labels are unique in the sampled label set.
redundancy.label_quality.label_uniquenes.limitations: Normalized labels are language- and sampling-dependent and do not prove semantic uniqueness.
redundancy.label_quality.label_uniquenes.empty_case: No eligible labels: rate is null (N/A); duplicate candidate counts remain 0.

temporal.date_format_validation.complian.label: Temporal literal validity rate
temporal.date_format_validation.complian.formula: valid ISO-parseable temporal literals / sampled temporal literals * 100.
temporal.date_format_validation.complian.source_basis: XML Schema date lexical forms, OWL-Time temporal representation, syntactic validity in KG quality literature.
temporal.date_format_validation.complian.rationale: Tests machine-readable temporal syntax for event timestamps.
temporal.date_format_validation.complian.limitations: Syntactic validity does not guarantee historical correctness.
temporal.date_format_validation.complian.empty_case: No applicable temporal values or intervals: rate/value is null (N/A), with an explicit status.

temporal.temporal_granularity.granularit.label: Temporal granularity distribution
temporal.temporal_granularity.granularit.formula: count(values at granularity g) / sampled temporal values * 100.
temporal.temporal_granularity.granularit.source_basis: OWL-Time supports multiple temporal positions/granularities; event-KG literature emphasizes temporal anchoring.
temporal.temporal_granularity.granularit.rationale: Describes whether the dataset encodes years, months, days, or timestamps.
temporal.temporal_granularity.granularit.limitations: Granularity is not inherently better or worse without a task requirement.
temporal.temporal_granularity.granularit.empty_case: No applicable temporal values or intervals: rate/value is null (N/A), with an explicit status.

temporal.temporal_coverage.temporal_cove.label: Temporal coverage
temporal.temporal_coverage.temporal_cove.formula: events with sem:hasBeginTimeStamp or sem:hasEndTimeStamp / direct sem:Event instances * 100.
temporal.temporal_coverage.temporal_cove.source_basis: Profile-relative completeness in KG/Linked Data quality; SEM/EventKG event-time role.
temporal.temporal_coverage.temporal_cove.rationale: Time is a core event argument, so coverage is a profile-relative completeness measure.
temporal.temporal_coverage.temporal_cove.limitations: Checks explicit begin/end predicates only; it does not infer time from relation nodes.
temporal.temporal_coverage.temporal_cove.empty_case: No applicable temporal values or intervals: rate/value is null (N/A), with an explicit status.

temporal.semantic_validation.consistency.label: Interval validity rate
temporal.semantic_validation.consistency.formula: events with parseable start/end and end >= start / checked start-end events * 100.
temporal.semantic_validation.consistency.source_basis: OWL-Time interval semantics; temporal consistency principles.
temporal.semantic_validation.consistency.thesis_use: core quality metric where start/end intervals exist
temporal.semantic_validation.consistency.rationale: Checks a directly meaningful contradiction in event intervals.
temporal.semantic_validation.consistency.limitations: Only applies to explicit start/end timestamps and does not reason over uncertain dates.
temporal.semantic_validation.consistency.empty_case: No applicable temporal values or intervals: rate/value is null (N/A), with an explicit status.

temporal.temporal_density.temporal_span_.label: Temporal span
temporal.temporal_density.temporal_span_.provenance_type: custom descriptive metric grounded in temporal distribution analysis
temporal.temporal_density.temporal_span_.source_basis: OWL-Time temporal positions; event dataset coverage analysis.
temporal.temporal_density.temporal_span_.rationale: Describes the historical extent of the event corpus.
temporal.temporal_density.temporal_span_.limitations: Span is scope, not quality; large span can hide sparse coverage.
temporal.temporal_density.temporal_span_.empty_case: No applicable temporal values or intervals: rate/value is null (N/A), with an explicit status.

temporal.temporal_density.avg_events_per.label: Average events per decade in observed span
temporal.temporal_density.avg_events_per.formula: dated events / number of decades from the minimum to maximum observed year, including empty decades.
temporal.temporal_density.avg_events_per.source_basis: Temporal distribution analysis; thesis-specific event-corpus summary.
temporal.temporal_density.avg_events_per.rationale: Summarizes temporal distribution density for context.
temporal.temporal_density.avg_events_per.limitations: Not a standard quality score and depends on domain history.
temporal.temporal_density.avg_events_per.empty_case: No applicable temporal values or intervals: rate/value is null (N/A), with an explicit status.

temporal.temporal_density.coverage_gaps.label: Missing decades in observed span
temporal.temporal_density.coverage_gaps.formula: Count of decades with zero begin-time events between the observed minimum and maximum year.
temporal.temporal_density.coverage_gaps.rationale: Flags temporal holes inside the represented span.
temporal.temporal_density.coverage_gaps.limitations: A missing decade can reflect source scope rather than poor quality.
temporal.temporal_density.coverage_gaps.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
temporal.temporal_density.coverage_gaps.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

schema.label_coverage_rate.label: Label coverage
schema.label_coverage_rate.formula: events with rdfs:label / total sem:Event instances * 100.
schema.label_coverage_rate.source_basis: Profile-relative completeness in KG quality literature; rdfs:label as RDF labeling convention.
schema.label_coverage_rate.rationale: Labels are required by the evaluation profile for event identification.
schema.label_coverage_rate.limitations: Does not check label correctness, language coverage, or ambiguity.
schema.label_coverage_rate.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: profile rates are null (N/A); property count remains descriptive.

schema.date_coverage_rate.label: Date coverage
schema.date_coverage_rate.formula: events with sem:hasBeginTimeStamp or sem:hasEndTimeStamp / total direct sem:Event instances * 100.
schema.date_coverage_rate.provenance_type: adapted from completeness and event-modeling literature
schema.date_coverage_rate.source_basis: KG completeness literature; SEM/EventKG event-time modeling.
schema.date_coverage_rate.rationale: Measures event-time argument completeness under the thesis profile.
schema.date_coverage_rate.limitations: Measures explicit SEM timestamps only; it does not infer dates from other predicates.
schema.date_coverage_rate.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: profile rates are null (N/A); property count remains descriptive.

schema.schema_conformance_rate.label: Minimal event-profile conformance rate
schema.schema_conformance_rate.formula: events with rdfs:label, (sem:hasBeginTimeStamp or sem:hasEndTimeStamp), and sem:hasPlace / total direct sem:Event instances * 100.
schema.schema_conformance_rate.source_basis: Closed application-profile validation principle; completeness literature under explicit profile requirements.
schema.schema_conformance_rate.thesis_use: core quality metric if described as profile-relative
schema.schema_conformance_rate.rationale: Captures how many events satisfy the declared minimal event profile.
schema.schema_conformance_rate.limitations: Not RDF/OWL semantic conformance; it is a closed-profile audit.
schema.schema_conformance_rate.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: profile rates are null (N/A); property count remains descriptive.

schema.non_standard_properties_count.label: Non-allowlisted property count
schema.non_standard_properties_count.formula: Count of event predicates whose namespace is outside the configured allow-list.
schema.non_standard_properties_count.source_basis: Vocabulary/schema profiling practice; thesis-specific namespace allow-list.
schema.non_standard_properties_count.rationale: Surfaces unexpected vocabulary use for manual review.
schema.non_standard_properties_count.limitations: Non-allowlisted does not mean incorrect; allow-list choice must be declared.
schema.non_standard_properties_count.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: profile rates are null (N/A); property count remains descriptive.

completeness.schema_coverage_percentage.label: Event-class schema coverage
completeness.schema_coverage_percentage.formula: used event classes / declared event classes * 100.
completeness.schema_coverage_percentage.source_basis: Pipino/Farber-style schema completeness adapted to KG profiles.
completeness.schema_coverage_percentage.rationale: Compares used event classes to the declared event-class profile.
completeness.schema_coverage_percentage.limitations: Measures class usage against schema, not real-world population completeness.
completeness.schema_coverage_percentage.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: event-profile rates are null (N/A); schema coverage remains schema-relative.

completeness.population_completeness_per.label: Minimal population completeness
completeness.population_completeness_per.formula: direct sem:Event instances with label, begin or end time, and place / all direct sem:Event instances * 100.
completeness.population_completeness_per.source_basis: Profile-relative completeness; column/property completeness adapted to event resources.
completeness.population_completeness_per.rationale: Measures required event-facet presence under a closed profile.
completeness.population_completeness_per.limitations: Place is profile-required here even though some event classes may legitimately have no place.
completeness.population_completeness_per.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: event-profile rates are null (N/A); schema coverage remains schema-relative.

completeness.class_usage_efficiency_perc.label: Class usage efficiency
completeness.class_usage_efficiency_perc.formula: used event classes / total event instances * 100.
completeness.class_usage_efficiency_perc.rationale: Shows diversity of event classes relative to instance count.
completeness.class_usage_efficiency_perc.limitations: Not a recognized quality metric and can be misleading for small datasets.
completeness.class_usage_efficiency_perc.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
completeness.class_usage_efficiency_perc.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

completeness.population_completeness.lab.label: Profile label coverage
completeness.population_completeness.lab.formula: events with rdfs:label / total sem:Event instances * 100.
completeness.population_completeness.lab.rationale: Checks required textual identification under the event profile.
completeness.population_completeness.lab.limitations: Does not validate label quality or multilingual coverage.
completeness.population_completeness.lab.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: event-profile rates are null (N/A); schema coverage remains schema-relative.

completeness.population_completeness.tem.label: Profile temporal coverage
completeness.population_completeness.tem.formula: events with sem:hasBeginTimeStamp or sem:hasEndTimeStamp / total direct sem:Event instances * 100.
completeness.population_completeness.tem.source_basis: Profile-relative KG completeness and event-time role modeling.
completeness.population_completeness.tem.rationale: Checks required temporal anchoring under the event profile.
completeness.population_completeness.tem.limitations: Does not validate semantic correctness of dates.
completeness.population_completeness.tem.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: event-profile rates are null (N/A); schema coverage remains schema-relative.

completeness.population_completeness.loc.label: Profile place coverage
completeness.population_completeness.loc.formula: events with sem:hasPlace / total sem:Event instances * 100.
completeness.population_completeness.loc.provenance_type: adapted from completeness and event-modeling literature
completeness.population_completeness.loc.source_basis: Event role completeness from SEM/event-centric KG modeling.
completeness.population_completeness.loc.thesis_use: core quality metric when place is required by the profile
completeness.population_completeness.loc.rationale: Checks spatial argument presence for events.
completeness.population_completeness.loc.limitations: Some event classes may not require place; class-specific eligibility would be stronger.
completeness.population_completeness.loc.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: event-profile rates are null (N/A); schema coverage remains schema-relative.

type_consistency.average_domain_conformi.label: Evidence-weighted domain conformity
type_consistency.average_domain_conformi.formula: all conforming domain checks / all applicable domain checks * 100.
type_consistency.average_domain_conformi.provenance_type: adapted from Farber KG consistency metrics
type_consistency.average_domain_conformi.source_basis: Farber et al. domain/range consistency under explicit OWA/CWA caveats; RDFS subclass closure.
type_consistency.average_domain_conformi.thesis_use: core quality metric with applicability denominator
type_consistency.average_domain_conformi.rationale: Checks closed-profile subject type compatibility for declared property domains.
type_consistency.average_domain_conformi.limitations: RDFS domain is entailment, not an integrity constraint; this must be framed as profile validation.
type_consistency.average_domain_conformi.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
type_consistency.average_domain_conformi.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

type_consistency.average_range_conformit.label: Evidence-weighted range conformity
type_consistency.average_range_conformit.formula: all conforming datatype and object-class range checks / all applicable range checks * 100.
type_consistency.average_range_conformit.source_basis: Farber relation-range consistency; RDF Schema range semantics; XML Schema datatypes.
type_consistency.average_range_conformit.thesis_use: core quality metric with applicability denominator
type_consistency.average_range_conformit.rationale: Checks literal datatype compatibility where the profile declares a datatype range.
type_consistency.average_range_conformit.limitations: Closed-profile interpretation; RDFS range normally entails rather than constrains type.
type_consistency.average_range_conformit.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
type_consistency.average_range_conformit.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

type_consistency.overall_type_consistenc.label: Closed-profile explicit type-alignment summary
type_consistency.overall_type_consistenc.formula: all explicitly aligned domain and range checks / all applicable declared domain and range checks * 100; null if none apply.
type_consistency.overall_type_consistenc.provenance_type: custom closed-profile aggregate over adapted consistency checks
type_consistency.overall_type_consistenc.source_basis: Custom summary informed by RDF/RDFS domain and range semantics and closed-profile validation practice.
type_consistency.overall_type_consistenc.rationale: Provides a compact evidence-weighted summary of explicit type and datatype alignment.
type_consistency.overall_type_consistenc.limitations: Missing explicit types are non-alignment under this closed profile, not RDF/OWL logical inconsistency; interpret with applicability counts.
type_consistency.overall_type_consistenc.empty_case: No applicable domain/range evidence: score is null (N/A), not 100%.

type_consistency.applicable_domain_check.label: Applicable domain checks
type_consistency.applicable_domain_check.formula: Sum of property usages for analyzed properties with declared domains.
type_consistency.applicable_domain_check.source_basis: Required by Farber-style caveat that empty constraint sets can yield vacuous scores.
type_consistency.applicable_domain_check.rationale: Prevents overinterpreting high conformity when few triples were actually checked.
type_consistency.applicable_domain_check.limitations: Only covers the first max_properties_analyzed property definitions.
type_consistency.applicable_domain_check.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
type_consistency.applicable_domain_check.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

type_consistency.applicable_range_checks.label: Applicable datatype range checks
type_consistency.applicable_range_checks.formula: Sum of property usages for analyzed properties with XSD datatype ranges.
type_consistency.applicable_range_checks.source_basis: Required by Farber-style consistency interpretation and datatype/range validation practice.
type_consistency.applicable_range_checks.rationale: Shows how much evidence supports range-conformity scores.
type_consistency.applicable_range_checks.limitations: Only datatype ranges are checked by the current implementation.
type_consistency.applicable_range_checks.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
type_consistency.applicable_range_checks.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

entity_richness.avg_properties_per_event.label: Average distinct-predicate richness
entity_richness.avg_properties_per_event.formula: mean_e count(distinct outgoing predicates other than rdf:type attached to direct event e).
entity_richness.avg_properties_per_event.source_basis: Adapted from OntoQA attribute richness; event-level descriptive richness is thesis-specific.
entity_richness.avg_properties_per_event.rationale: Measures the amount of description attached to event nodes.
entity_richness.avg_properties_per_event.limitations: Distinct predicates may still be administrative; correctness and relevance are not measured.
entity_richness.avg_properties_per_event.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: richness and sparsity are null (N/A).

entity_richness.sparse_entities_percenta.label: Sparse event rate
entity_richness.sparse_entities_percenta.formula: events with fewer than 3 distinct outgoing predicates excluding rdf:type / analyzed events * 100.
entity_richness.sparse_entities_percenta.limitations: The threshold is arbitrary and should be treated as a diagnostic, not a standard.
entity_richness.sparse_entities_percenta.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: richness and sparsity are null (N/A).

mapping_coverage.external_link_rate.label: owl:sameAs external-link coverage
mapping_coverage.external_link_rate.formula: events with at least one owl:sameAs link / total events * 100.
mapping_coverage.external_link_rate.source_basis: Linked Data interlinking quality; OWL owl:sameAs identity predicate.
mapping_coverage.external_link_rate.rationale: Measures external identity-link presence for event resources.
mapping_coverage.external_link_rate.limitations: Coverage does not prove correctness; owl:sameAs misuse is common.
mapping_coverage.external_link_rate.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: all mapping rates are null (N/A).

mapping_coverage.wikidata_coverage.label: Wikidata link coverage
mapping_coverage.wikidata_coverage.formula: events with owl:sameAs on a Wikidata HTTP(S) host / total direct sem:Event instances * 100.
mapping_coverage.wikidata_coverage.source_basis: Adapted from Linked Data interlinking coverage by target source.
mapping_coverage.wikidata_coverage.rationale: Shows grounding to a major external KG.
mapping_coverage.wikidata_coverage.limitations: Host-pattern detection does not check link correctness, equivalence semantics, currency, or resolvability.
mapping_coverage.wikidata_coverage.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: all mapping rates are null (N/A).

mapping_coverage.dbpedia_coverage.label: DBpedia link coverage
mapping_coverage.dbpedia_coverage.formula: events with owl:sameAs on a DBpedia HTTP(S) host (including language subdomains) / total direct sem:Event instances * 100.
mapping_coverage.dbpedia_coverage.source_basis: Adapted from Linked Data interlinking coverage by target source.
mapping_coverage.dbpedia_coverage.limitations: Host-pattern detection does not check link correctness, equivalence semantics, currency, or resolvability.
mapping_coverage.dbpedia_coverage.empty_case: No direct sem:Event instances: all mapping rates are null (N/A).

predicate_usage.total_unique_predicates.label: Unique predicate count
predicate_usage.total_unique_predicates.limitations: More predicates do not necessarily indicate better quality.
predicate_usage.total_unique_predicates.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
predicate_usage.total_unique_predicates.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

predicate_usage.top_10_concentration.label: Top-10 predicate concentration
predicate_usage.top_10_concentration.formula: sum(counts of 10 most used predicates) / total triples * 100.
predicate_usage.top_10_concentration.source_basis: Concentration analysis over categorical frequency distributions.
predicate_usage.top_10_concentration.rationale: Shows whether a small predicate subset dominates the graph.
predicate_usage.top_10_concentration.limitations: Not a direct quality metric; compact schemas may legitimately be concentrated.
predicate_usage.top_10_concentration.implementation: supporting output in the analyzer named by its metric path
predicate_usage.top_10_concentration.empty_case: Interpret with its associated core metric and denominator.

predicate_usage.singleton_predicates.label: Singleton predicate count
predicate_usage.singleton_predicates.formula: Count of predicates used exactly once.
predicate_usage.singleton_predicates.rationale: Flags rare predicates that may indicate schema noise or long-tail modeling.

predicate_usage.gini_coefficient.formula: (2 * sum_i i*x_i) / (n * sum_i x_i) - (n + 1) / n after sorting counts.

predicate_usage.normalized_shannon_entro.label: Normalized predicate Shannon entropy
predicate_usage.normalized_shannon_entro.formula: H / log2(k), where k is the number of predicates.
predicate_usage.normalized_shannon_entro.source_basis: Normalized Shannon entropy over categorical distributions.
predicate_usage.normalized_shannon_entro.rationale: Allows predicate-diversity comparison across different vocabulary sizes.
